text: Lumera is launching, and we want you in the room.
Friday, September the fourth. Three thirty, at the Jafar Center.
A finance Kahoot with prizes. A startup showcase. A raffle.
And yes, the drinks and snacks are on us.
Then at seven twenty five, we go live. Together.
But there are only sixty spots.
The first sixty to sign up get in. The link is in our caption!
Tag a friend, and see you there.
